ValidationRule.description: If Override Rating checkbox is false then the 5x5 and 10x10 fields should be empty.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName != 'AP_Adjust_Premium_Transaction', Override_Rating__c = false, OR(NOT(ISNULL( Override_5_5__c )), NOT(ISNULL( Override_10_10__c ))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Override Rating must be checked to fill the values in 5x5 and 10x10!
